subject: Quick quote / short video for BrightLayer case study & review
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.s@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.p@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick quote / short video for BrightLayer case study & review

Hi Ethan —

Hope you're doing well. We're putting together a short customer showcase for BrightLayer and wanted to ask whether you'd be open to two small items:

1) A 1–2 sentence quote we can use on our website and the Capterra listing.
2) (Optional) A ~60-second phone/video clip saying what you like about Redwood Inference (totally casual — we can use audio-only if better).

Instead of sending a gift card, BrightLayer can choose one of two options: a $250 donation to a charity you pick, or a $100 Amazon/e-gift card for the person who records the clip. No pressure on the video — the sentence quote alone is totally fine.

I've attached a one-pager with suggested bullets and a quick upload link for videos. If you're able, could you send the quote or video by next Friday (2026-04-16)? If that timeline doesn't work, tell me what does and we'll adapt.

If you'd rather I send this to someone else on your team, please point me to them and I'll follow up.

Thanks again for being such a great partner — your feedback has already helped shape our routing and cache improvements.

Best,
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
maya.s@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

Attachment: brightlayer-one-pager.pdf
Attachment: upload-instructions.txt

From: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@brightlayer.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.s@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-06T14:03:21-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick quote / short video for BrightLayer case study & review

Hi Maya —

Thanks for reaching out. Happy to help. A 1–2 sentence quote is easy for me, and I'm willing to record a short audio clip next week if that helps. I prefer the donation option — we have a company-charity fund and the team likes that.

A couple quick Qs:
- Deadline: you asked for 4/16; is there any flexibility to do 4/20? We have a product sprint this week.
- Where do I upload the audio/video? I see an upload token in the notes but just want to confirm.

If it's helpful, here's a quick potential quote to start the ball rolling — feel free to edit: "Redwood's serving runtime reduced our inference latency and simplified our deployment strategy, saving us DevOps time while keeping costs predictable."

Best,
Ethan
Ethan Wu
Head of Platform Engineering | BrightLayer
ethan.wu@brightlayer.com | (617) 555-2090

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.s@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.p@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-07T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick quote / short video for BrightLayer case study & review

Hi Ethan —

This is great, thanks — the quote you shared is perfect and we've edited slightly for tightness; we'll send any final copy for sign-off before publishing. 4/20 is totally fine for the clip.

Upload details: 
- Video/audio: https://uploads.example.com/brightlayer-video/UPLOAD_TOKEN_abc123 (drop in MP4 or M4A)
- If you'd rather send a file to me directly, you can reply and I'll share a secure S3 link.

Suggested script (if helpful): 1–2 lines on the problem you faced, 1 line on outcome (latency/cost/ops). No need for production quality — phone audio is fine.

We'll make the $250 donation to the charity you designate once the piece publishes. If you want the $100 e-gift instead for the individual who records, just say so.

I'll draft the final one-sentence variant and send for sign-off before it goes live. Appreciate the help — this really helps other platform teams evaluate the tradeoffs of inference serving.

Best,
Maya
Attachment: brightlayer-one-pager.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.s@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.p@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-08T10:30:12-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick quote / short video for BrightLayer case study & review

Maya — quick internal note: once the content is live, I'll coordinate the charity donation and get a receipt (we need that for the customer's records). Dev, can you stand by for any minimal edits to the clip or to pull a 15s highlight for our homepage?

I'll also log this in the HubSpot deal (DL-2025-0987) and add the Capterra submission step to the close checklist.

Thanks — Rishi

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.s@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12T16:20:45-07:00
Subject: Live: BrightLayer quote + donation receipt

Hi Ethan —

Quick update: we've published the one-sentence quote on our customer page and submitted the short blurb to Capterra. Preview link: https://redwood.ai/customers/brightlayer (live internally, will be public by EOD).

Donation: we've processed the $250 donation to the BrightLayer Charity Fund and attached the donation receipt. Attachment: donation_receipt.pdf

Thank you again for taking the time to provide the quote and for choosing the donation option — we really appreciate it. If you sent a clip and I missed it, please resend and we'll drop it on the homepage hero rotation.

Best,
Maya
Attachment: donation_receipt.pdf
